GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy, while helping our customers power economies and deliver the electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life. Are you excited at the opportunity to electrify and decarbonize the world?
  

  

What impact you’ll make
  

  

As a member of the Gas Power Controls Program Management Office (PMO) team, you will be responsible for leading and facilitating the execution of New Product Introduction (NPI) engineering development programs through all phases of the Gas Power product life cycle. As a key leadership position within the organization, this role is essential for effective operation through active management of project execution, risks and mitigations to meet our commitments to the business, while maintaining critical business metrics to ensure quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of our NPI deliverables.
**Job Description**
===================

* Provide program management execution for assigned projects in accordance with GE Gas Power Program Managers Standard Work procedure.
* Create and maintain internal and external project schedules.

* Guide internal and external execution teams through the NPI Development Process, assuring the proper adherence to engineering policies and procedures.
* Coordinate activities between engineering sub\-functions to ensure all project deliverables are met on time, complete, properly tested, and documented.
* Actively manage program risks and mitigations to avoid execution misses.
* Communicate program status and issues to the engineering and commercial stakeholders.
* Provide regular spending status and projections to the Business Operations and Quality teams.

* Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Mathematics, or Computer Science.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in engineering or program/project management of engineered systems.
  

  

  

**Desired Qualifications**

  

  

* Exceptional communication skills and the ability to interface with leadership with confidence and clarity.
* Knowledge of GE Power project tracking tools, processes, and practices.
* Engineering program graduate or advanced engineering degree.
* Prior experience in electronic hardware or software development.
* Knowledgeable of engineering, manufacturing and customer service processes.
* Strong organizational/ project execution skills and prior success in working with or leading cross\-functional teams.
* Customer satisfaction mindset.
* Demonstrated leadership, team building, and communication skills.
* Highly motivated, energetic, confident, self\-starting personal characteristics.
* Influences through others; builds direct and "behind the scenes" support for ideas. Identifies opportunities and actively pursues appropriate changes with the input and support of the team.

The Business Intelligence team is a high\-impact group of business operations professionals who love data and technology. Program Management

JOB SUMMARY

Kadir.ai is recruiting a Technical Program Manager on behalf of a rapidly growing artificial intelligence company building infrastructure for reinforcement\-learning training data and evaluations.

In this role, you will lead complex, time\-sensitive data and evaluation programs for frontier AI organizations, data vendors, and internal teams. You will translate ambiguous technical requirements into executable programs, coordinate stakeholders and dependencies, manage delivery from initial scoping through completion, and ensure that delivered datasets and evaluations are useful, reliable, and representative.

This position requires a combination of technical understanding, program ownership, data\-quality judgment, operational discipline, and clear communication. You will also help improve the processes, documentation, automation, and internal tools needed to deliver increasingly complex programs at scale.

* This is a full\-time position.
* San Francisco or Singapore is preferred.
* Remote candidates are welcome if they can maintain approximately 70–80% working\-hour overlap with either the San Francisco or Singapore time zone.
* Relocation and visa support are available for strong candidates.
* Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
* The selection process includes an initial screening, two technical interviews, and a two\-to\-three\-day structured work trial.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Own complex technical programs from initial scoping through production, quality assurance, delivery, and retrospective
* Translate ambiguous requests into clearly defined requirements, milestones, owners, dependencies, timelines, and acceptance criteria
* Coordinate research, engineering, operations, marketplace, and customer\-facing teams
* Manage data\-delivery pipelines and external vendors throughout the project lifecycle
* Track program risks, blockers, dependencies, and changing requirements
* Develop and improve data\-quality procedures using quantitative signals and qualitative inspection
* Evaluate whether datasets and AI evaluations are useful, reliable, representative, and aligned with customer requirements
* Establish quality\-control checkpoints and clear delivery standards
* Maintain momentum while priorities, scope, and technical requirements evolve
* Improve workflows, documentation, automation, and cross\-functional handoffs
* Build repeatable operating processes for increasingly complex programs
* Communicate program status, risks, decisions, and technical findings to internal and external stakeholders
* Lead retrospectives and convert program lessons into measurable process improvements
* Feed delivery insights back into research, platform, and marketplace products
* Support multiple high\-priority programs while maintaining delivery quality and accountability

REQUIRED SKILLS

* Technical program or project management
* Experience leading complex technical programs from planning through delivery
* Ability to translate ambiguous technical requests into executable plans
* Strong understanding of milestones, dependencies, risks, ownership, and acceptance criteria
* Quantitative and qualitative data\-quality judgment
* Experience managing cross\-functional stakeholders
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-moving and changing environment
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills
* Experience managing vendors, partners, or external delivery teams
* Ability to assess whether technical deliverables satisfy customer requirements
* Ability to maintain approximately 70–80% working\-hour overlap with San Francisco or Singapore

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience supporting artificial intelligence or machine\-learning programs
* Experience with AI evaluations, benchmarks, or reinforcement\-learning workflows
* Familiarity with RLHF or human\-feedback programs
* Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop data pipelines
* Experience with annotation, labeling, or expert\-data\-collection programs
* Experience in AI/ML data operations or applied research
* Background in support engineering or forward\-deployed engineering
* Experience working with frontier AI organizations or highly technical customers
* Familiarity with Python, SQL, APIs, data pipelines, or analytical tooling
* Experience designing quality\-assurance procedures for complex datasets
* Early\-stage startup experience
* Experience coordinating distributed teams across multiple time zones

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

* Demonstrated ownership of complex technical programs in one or more of the following areas:
* Artificial intelligence or machine learning
* Data operations
* Applied research
* Support engineering
* Forward\-deployed engineering
* Software or platform delivery
* Technical customer implementation
* Experience managing a program through requirements, production, quality assurance, delivery, and retrospective
* Experience maintaining delivery momentum as requirements and priorities change
* Technical judgment, program ownership, and execution ability are more important than a fixed number of years of experience

EDUCATION REQUIRED

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, Program Management, or a related discipline is preferred
* A master’s degree or relevant research experience is beneficial but not required

Equivalent professional experience and a strong record of technical program delivery will be considered

jobs.description:
Counterpart: Value\-based care, at the point of care.



At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.



We are hiring an Implementation Manager on the Counterpart Assistant team. In this role, you will lead the customer\-facing work of bringing new provider practices and TINs from late\-stage prospects through successful launch on Counterpart Assistant. You will partner closely with account management to hand off new customers, own the customer relationship through implementation, and drive each launch to completion on time and at quality.



You will independently lead multiple concurrent implementations and the cross\-functional work that makes each launch happen. Partnering with account management, support, product, and engineering internally and with providers, office managers, and clinical leads on the customer side: you will drive accountability across every stakeholder and deliver results through influence. Beyond running individual launches, you will help shape the implementation playbook itself — identifying what slows launches down, proposing changes, and driving improvements that reduce time\-to\-launch and lift customer satisfaction. Strong project management fundamentals, clear customer communication, working knowledge of clinical data, and technical fluency will let you keep complex, multi\-stakeholder launches on track.


### **As an Implementation Manager, you will:**


* Own the customer relationship through implementation: you are the primary point of contact for the customer's technical implementation from project kickoff to post go live steady state.
* Lead end\-to\-end project plans for multiple concurrent, multi\-step implementations, keeping internal and customer teams aligned on scope, timeline, and status.
* Partner cross\-functionally with account management, support, product, and engineering to unblock issues, coordinate handoffs, and keep implementations moving on schedule.
* Own the outcomes of each implementation: surface risks early, drive resolution across teams, and hold each launch accountable to its target date and quality bar.
* Apply technical judgment to monitor and address potential integration issues that arise during implementations, working alongside product and engineering to ensure a successful integration and product launch.
* Drive continuous improvement of the implementation process: define and refine the playbook, tooling, and templates that reduce time\-to\-launch and raise the quality bar for every customer experience.
* Represent the customer's voice internally — capture feedback and pain points from implementations and channel them to product, engineering, and support to improve future launches.


**Success in this Role Looks Like:**


* Over the first 90 days, you hit the ground running: shadowing active implementations, learning the moving parts of the process (standard EHR integrations, internal system configurations and project plans), and taking ownership of your first launch.
* Within the first 6 months, you are the customer\-facing lead on multiple concurrent implementations, delivering launches on time and with a high customer satisfaction bar. Customers describe you as trusted, responsive, and a reason they feel confident in Counterpart.
* You have identified at least one meaningful improvement to the implementation process — a template, a workflow change, a handoff refinement — and driven it to adoption across the team.
* Over time, your performance is measured by the consistency, speed, and on\-target delivery of customer implementations, by the strength of the relationships you build with customer stakeholders throughout the process, and by the cumulative improvements you drive into the implementation playbook itself.

### **You should get in touch if:**


* You have 5\-8 years of experience leading technical product implementations in a customer\-facing role, with a strong track record of on\-time, high\-quality launches — and of running multiple implementations in parallel.
* You have 2\+ years of experience in healthcare technology implementations working with provider practices, ideally including EHR standard integrations.
* You have exceptional customer\-facing skills — you build trust quickly with providers, office managers, and clinical leads, communicate clearly under pressure, and manage escalations calmly and directly.
* You are an expert in project management: you set the plan, track it, and drive accountability across internal and customer teams that don't report to you.
* You have strong technical judgment and are comfortable diagnosing potential integration issues and scope creep of the overall project.
* You are a strong communicator, clearly documenting project status and potential risks internally and externally.
* You are motivated by process improvement: you notice friction in the way work gets done, propose better approaches, and drive them to adoption without needing a mandate.
* You lead through influence, not authority: you know how to align stakeholders, resolve conflict, and hold the room accountable to outcomes.

**About the job**

**Title:** Senior Operations Project Manager

**Industry:** Power Distribution / Electrification / Critical Infrastructure Equipment

**Segments:** Data Centers, Hyperscalers, Utilities, Power Generation

**Location:** Remote (U.S.) \| Travel as Needed (up to 25%)

**Compensation:** Competitive Base Salary \+ Performance Bonus\[KK1]

**Reporting Manager:** Director, Project Management

**About PDM**

PDM is one of the fastest growing manufacturers in the electrical power industry. PDM delivers mission\-critical, utility\-grade products across industry sectors powering the modern world, including **HV/MV/LV transformers,** **circuit breakers, gas\-insulated switchgear, and other transmission\-grade equipment** to a global portfolio of customers. PDM’s essential solutions support the backbone of **data centers, AI hyperscalers, utilities infrastructure, power generation, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, and the oil \& gas infrastructure**. With explosive growth in AI and demand for power, this is a career\-defining opportunity to contribute to a growing global market with long\-term momentum.

**Position Overview**

We are hiring a Senior Operations Project Manager to bridge the gap between customers, commissioning teams, design engineers, factory operations, and field service partners. As the Senior Operations Project Manager, you will support the sales team in facilitating customer solutions and lead the execution of complex electrical distribution projects for data centers, hyperscalers, oil \& gas, clean power, and other industrial clients.

This is a customer\-facing operations role where you will execute timelines, track and communicate progress using project management methodologies, identify and mitigate risks, coordinate startup and after\-sales services, manage project budgets, and maintain project stakeholder alignment throughout the equipment lifecycle. Ideal for someone who is process driven and thrives on clarity, communication, and fast\-moving infrastructure environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Act as the primary liaison between customer stakeholders, internal PDM stakeholders, factory teams, logistics teams, and field service partners.

· Track project schedules, KPIs, changes, risks, budgets, and approval timelines.

· Lead project kickoff and stakeholder governance meetings.

· Manage the execution of technical efforts in the field.

· Provide technical support for internal teams, service partners, and customer inquiries in collaboration with factory and engineering teams.

· Support technical design reviews and submittal packages, transportation logistics, service and spare parts proposals, field documentation, and equipment lifecycle management in collaboration with factory and engineering teams.

· Support sales activities to validate customer solutions and generate business growth through operational excellence.

· Travel to domestic and international manufacturing and customer sites as needed for project coordination and quality assurance.

· Promote workplace safety and employee wellbeing.

**What You Offer**

· End\-to\-end project management leadership in the electrical industry

· Ability to read electrical drawings, one\-line diagrams, schedules, and technical submittals

· Familiarity with Bluebeam, Smartsheet, Microsoft 365, MS Dynamics, ERP, CRM, and/or equivalent project tracking tools

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills; bilingual (Mandarin) is a plus

· Detail\-oriented self\-starter with the ability to lead, take initiative, assess risks, problem solve, manage process, and strive for continuous improvement

· Willingness to periodically work outside of standard work hours for global coordination efforts

· Ability to travel domestically and internationally (up to 25%)

**Why Join Us:**

· $150K\+ and up to 20% performance bonus

· Full benefits package (Health, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO, parental leave)

· Be a key player in high\-growth sectors, like data center infrastructure and energy transition

· Work within a **collaborative, entrepreneurial culture** with strong cross\-functional support

· Shape the go\-to\-market strategy in your vertical and make an industry\-wide impact

**Qualifications**

· 10\+ years of project management experience in electrical industry

· Ability to work independently and remotely

· Ability to lead cross\-functional teams

· Bachelor degree in Engineering (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, etc.), Construction Management, Business, or related field is preferred; MBA is a plus

· Experience working in HV/MV electrical, industrial power equipment, or related industries is required

· Experience working with international teams is preferred

· Experience working with continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.) is preferred

· Bilingual (Mandarin) written and verbal abilities are a plus

With more than a decade of training AI models on billions of sales interactions, Backstory enables modern sales teams to ask questions and get the right answer in the moment directly within their existing AI workflows. Sales leaders from companies like Red Hat, Five9, Palo Alto Networks, Iron Mountain, TransUnion, Randstad and others rely on Backstory to get trusted answers wrapped in real business context helping them orchestrate deals more effectively and drive revenue.



By connecting every signal to the right accounts and opportunities, Backstory shows teams exactly what is happening and what to do next. Customers across industries including enterprise, cybersecurity, data and analytics, and defense use Backstory to drive trillions in pipeline and revenue.

* Take ownership of ambiguous security challenges from strategy and evaluation through implementation, measurement, and continuous improvement.

* Ability to translate complex technical threats and vulnerabilities into actionable solutions with Engineering, Product, IT, and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to independently evaluate security challenges and determine the right technical approach.

Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.


Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


**Project Manager, Professional Services**

PTC has a unique culture, which is fast\-paced, driven and self\-reliant. We are looking for talented, enthusiastic, and career\-minded individuals to join our Professional Services PMO organization where you will have the opportunity to lead consulting services projects while working with a well\-established and growing number of companies in a range of industries. From Aerospace \& Defense to High Tech to Industrial Products and even Footwear \& Apparel, PTC’s customer base is as far reaching as the products you use every day. As a member of the Global PMO team, you lead clients to value with PTC solutions, lead project teams, and drive the agenda for project execution, and manage all financial, schedule, quality, and resource management aspects of projects.


**Project Management Principal Duties**

* Lead and manage multiple projects to ensure the realization of value, quality, and on\-time delivery of defined scope.
* Lead a full project lifecycle leveraging either the traditional PMI Process or Scrum/Agile approach.
* Work as a liaison within the Global Services organization, and interface with the R\&D, Service Lifecycle Management Segment, Technical Support, Workforce Management, and all extended organizations to ensure that proper scope, resource pools and key dependencies are being defined and developed.
* Identify and schedule project deliverables, milestones and required tasks, providing early visibility to schedules/milestones that are at risk.
* Build detailed project plan and schedule for products across all processes, independently managing day\-day operational tactical aspects of multiple projects.
* Coordinate and facilitate communications with management and across teams.
* Maintain product knowledge to increase efficiency in delivery of products.
* Organize and lead business requirements and design sessions with key stakeholders and technology team. Works in conjunction with customers to analyze, design and develop requirements.
* Own contractual documents and manage contract changes.
* Jointly work with partners and support partner projects as needed.
* Maintain active engagement with existing customer base to ensure retention.
* Provide leadership and guidance to delivery team and customer team.
* Operates and participates in customer steering committees

**Client Leadership and Engagement**

* Plan, direct and lead project activities to ensure PTC’s technology solutions transform the way PTC clients create and service their products
* Define, align and document client vision and strategies (Roadmaps), and define joint program(PTC\-client) organizations; to include governance model involving executives from both PTC and the client
* Identify new business opportunities within the client and provide to the business development team
* Generate project growth within the current project by expanding the scope of the current project or defining and developing the next step of the Client Roadmap.
* Own the financials of their project to include cost, revenue, margin and investment.
* Provide a multi\-quarter forecast reflecting the revenue, margin and cost of the current project.
Work closely with Sales and business development to craft comprehensive account plans, strategies and financial models  
* 

**Health and growth of PTC’s services business**

* Manages an effective and profitable business engagement with potential for growth.
* Responsible for delivering client satisfaction leading to long\-term client relationships and growth.
* Manages all business forecasting including, revenue, margin, free\-work, bookings, and Estimate\-at\-Completion on a weekly basis.
* Owns and drives all escalation of technical, resource, and strategic issues across the client and internal PTC ecosystem.
* Ensure strategic initiatives are prioritized and delivered successfully.
* Implement Portfolio management and good practice.
* Provides oversight of key projects ensuring consistency of approach.
* Mentors and coaches as necessary to delivery team members.
* Provides enterprise\-wide best practice approaches such has governance, resourcing, risk management, and planning.

**Experience with some of these selected areas would be a distinct advantage:**

* Knowledge of and experience with industry\-specific processes in Aerospace and Defense, Medical Device, High\-tech Electronics, or Heavy Equipment manufacture
* Knowledge of and experience with after\-market service and supply\-chain operation
* Experience with Service Lifecycle Management (Service Parts Planning, Field Services) solution implementation.
* Experience with Cloud\-based, Software as a Service offerings.
* Demonstrated experience working in heavily regulated industries and environments
* Experience with Certinia
* PMP Certification

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 3 – 6 years of Project Management experience

*Availability for 25% of onsite travel to customer sites within the America’s.*

jobs.title: Security Manager
jobs.description:
**POSITION TITLE:** Security Manager


**LOCATION:** Remote


**CLEARANCE:** Must be able to obtain a High\-Risk Public Trust

  


**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

  



At APV, we’re more than a technology company — we’re a mission\-driven powerhouse transforming organizations through advanced technology and human ingenuity. Our expertise spans AI/ML, data architecture, low\-code/no\-code development, Agile DevSecOps, and cloud services, delivering scalable and meaningful solutions.



In our Emerging Technology Lab, innovation drives progress. Our teams create intelligent chatbots, AI\-powered assistants, robotic process automation (RPA), essay graders, and data analytics platforms. If you’re passionate about solving complex challenges and shaping the future, APV is the place for you. Since 2007, we’ve partnered with federal and state agencies to deliver IT, training, and consulting solutions that achieve mission\-critical outcomes. Built on accountability, integrity, and quality, we go beyond expectations. With 70\+ prime contracts and a proven record of client success, APV continues to grow — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

  


**At APV, we Always Provide Value**

  


**POSITION SUMMARY**

  


Seeking a mission\-driven Security Manager to support a large\-scale federal healthcare technology program. This role provides leadership across cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, continuous monitoring, incident response, and federal security governance.

  

**DUTIES**

  


* Lead security strategy, compliance, risk management, and continuous monitoring activities for complex federal information systems.
* Maintain ATO documentation, security artifacts, assessments, and authorization support packages.
* Oversee vulnerability management, POA\&M development, remediation tracking, and security reporting.
* Coordinate security assessments, audits, penetration testing, and continuous monitoring activities.
* Ensure compliance with NIST RMF, NIST 800\-53, FISMA, HIPAA, CMS security requirements, and federal cybersecurity standards.
* Support incident response, threat management, and security operations activities.
* Collaborate with architects, DevSecOps teams, developers, and government stakeholders to integrate security controls throughout the system lifecycle.
* Own the System Security Plan, security control assessments, and Authority to Operate (ATO) package, including support for reauthorization and for extending authorization to lower environments.
* Manage the POA\&M lifecycle end to end: intake, risk rating, remediation planning, evidence, and closure within agency\-defined timelines, with monthly reporting to government stakeholders.
* Apply NIST RMF, NIST SP 800\-53, FISMA, HIPAA, and agency\-specific control baselines such as CMS Acceptable Risk Safeguards (ARS) to a cloud\-hosted AWS environment.
* Coordinate independent assessments, penetration testing, and continuous monitoring, and serve as the primary security interface to government security and privacy officials.
* Work shoulder to shoulder with the DevSecOps Lead so that scanning, patching, and control evidence are automated in the pipeline instead of collected by hand.

  


**EDUCATION**

  



Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

  


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  


* Minimum 8 years of information security/cybersecurity experience, including at least 3 years leading security activities for complex information systems.
* Demonstrated knowledge of NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST SP 800\-53, FISMA, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, security assessments, POA\&M management, and system authorization processes. Ability to integrate security requirements and controls throughout the system development lifecycle and coordinate security activities with Government stakeholders.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a High\-Risk Public Trust or equivalent federal client access. This role supports sensitive federal programs and involves elevated access to systems and data.
* Position requires the current ability to obtain and maintain required access without interruption in alignment with long\-term program needs.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

  


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  


* CISSP, CISM, CGRC, or equivalent cybersecurity credentials. Direct experience with CMS or HHS authorization processes, CFACTS, the CMS Acceptable Risk Safeguards (ARS), FedRAMP\-authorized cloud services, and HIPAA/PHI environments is strongly preferred.

  


**ABOUT APV**

  



APV is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or marital status.

jobs.title: Financial IT Project Manager (5670)
jobs.description:
SMX is seeking a dynamic and experienced **Project Manager** to lead the implementation of our CFO Control Tower Budget and Spend (BAS) solution for a key federal government client. This role requires a leader who can expertly navigate the complexities of federal financial management projects, ensuring the successful deployment of a cutting\-edge planning and reporting tool built on the SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) platform.



This is a unique and exciting role that allows the right candidate to use their deep understanding of federal budgeting and planning processes to help build our next generation planning application. We are looking for an energetic and creative federal financial business analyst to take our solution to the next level and drive value for our federal customers. You will be working alongside a talented team of designers, developers and budget SMEs to help build, enhance, and roll out our best\-in\-class solution. This is a full\-time position that is 100% remote and will require minimal travel \<20% and requires a Public Trust clearance.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**



The ideal candidate will be responsible for the entire project lifecycle, from planning and execution to stakeholder management and final delivery. You will serve as the primary point of contact for the client, ensuring that our "Shared Vision. Outcome Assured." motto is realized through meticulous planning, clear communication, and a relentless focus on achieving mission objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Project Leadership: Direct and manage the full lifecycle of the CFO Control Tower BAS implementation project, including scope, schedule, budget, and quality, from initiation to closure.
* Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary liaison between federal client stakeholders, SMX technical teams, and third\-party vendors to ensure clear communication and alignment of project goals.
* Planning \& Execution: Develop and maintain a comprehensive project plan, outlining tasks, timelines, resource allocation, and dependencies. Proactively manage risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Technical Oversight: While not a hands\-on technical role, maintain a strong understanding of the SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) platform and the functional aspects of the BAS solution to guide the project effectively.
* Team Coordination: Lead a cross\-functional team of business analysts, data engineers, and solution architects, fostering a collaborative environment to break down stovepipes and deliver targeted capabilities.
* Reporting \& Governance: Provide regular, transparent status reports on project progress, risks, and financial health to both client leadership and SMX executive management.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure the final solution meets all client requirements, is delivered on time, within budget, and adheres to the highest standards of quality and federal security protocols.

**Required Skills \& Experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years' experience as a Project Manager leading complex IT or financial system implementations.
* Proven experience managing SAP ERP implementation and upgrade projects, demonstrating strong project management skills and a deep understanding of SAP systems.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects for U.S. Federal Government agencies.
* Strong understanding of the project management lifecycle and methodologies (e.g., PMP, Agile, Hybrid).
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage and influence diverse stakeholder groups.
* Must be a US Citizen and have the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.


**Desired Skills \& Experience**


* Experience in managing an SAP ERP or SAP EPM project is highly desirable.
* PMP Certification is highly desired.
* Direct experience with SAP solutions, particularly SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) for planning and reporting.
* Familiarity with federal budgeting, financial planning, and reporting processes (e.g., PPBE).
* Previous experience implementing COTS (Commercial Off\-The\-Shelf) or pre\-built software solutions.
* Experience managing projects with a significant data integration or business intelligence component.



\# LI\-SA1



\#CJPOST

  




At SMX®, we are a team of technical and domain experts dedicated to enabling your mission. From priority national security initiatives for the DoD to highly assured and compliant solutions for healthcare, we understand that digital transformation is key to your future success.



We share your vision for the future and strive to accelerate your impact on the world. We bring both cutting edge technology and an expansive view of what's possible to every engagement. Our delivery model and unique approaches harness our deep technical and domain knowledge, providing forward\-looking insights and practical solutions to power secure mission acceleration.

**Job Description**

At Sparklight/Cableone and our family of brands, we keep our customers and associates connected to what matters most. For our associates, that means: a thriving and rewarding career, respect for the communities where they live and work, a focus on health and wellness, an excellent work/life balance, and an open and inclusive workplace.

This position will provide technical assistance related to geographic information system data maintenance and development. This includes creating, compiling and maintaining data necessary for internal team request to support the business.  



  

**What you will do to contribute to the company's success**

  

Set forth below is a list of the essential duties and responsibilities (or "essential functions") of this position.


* Provide support for fiber optic and HFC network mapping utilizing ArcGIS and ArcFM software.
* Provides direct input on the development, design and maintenance of GIS datasets, geodatabases, and related applications developed on top of ESRI’s ArcGIS.
* Assists with data collection, attributing and editing of spatial data including data cleanup, data organization and map creation using ESRI’s ArcGIS software.
* Assists in updating of parcel data using ESRI’s ArcMap/ArcGIS Pro and REGRID data entry (coordinate geometry)
* Familiarity with ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Online and ArcFM
* Relational database analysis and modeling knowledge

* Perform general calculations and comprehend the theory and function of coordinate systems and geodetic projections.
* Work with internal teams such as Legal, Market Expansion and design teams to support GIS map requests.
Ensure all related fiber infrastructure geospatial inventories are in alignment with GIS best practices.  
*

* Bachelor’s degree, with focus on GIS.
* Experience producing or updating overlay maps to show information boundaries, utility locations, or topographic features on various base maps at different scales and coordinate systems.
* Demonstrated experience handling multiple priorities, organizing work to meet changing priorities, and working efficiently and effectively under pressure.
* Proven customer service with internal teams, with sense of urgency, attention to detail, and ability to handle situations diplomatically and across various levels of the organization.
Strong interactive communication and negotiation skills and an aptitude for problem\-solving.

**Desired Qualifications**

Built cloud\-native and designed for continuous iteration, MosaicOS™ is engineered to solve the industry’s most pressing challenges. Our platform expands clinical capacity, improves diagnostic quality by combining human expertise with AI, and turns operational complexity into strategic advantage through seamless integration or replacement of legacy imaging systems.
  
  

Every AI tool within MosaicOS™ is validated across tens of millions of exams to ensure safe, reliable and meaningful clinical impact. With a ransomware\-resistant design and built\-in redundancy, our platform is designed to ensure continuity of care and protect both patients and operations.

--------------------------


We're looking for a **Principal Information Security Analyst** to join the Information Risk Management (IRM) team within Corporate Information Security (CIS). You will leverage deep expertise in security policies, standards, controls, and industry best practices to perform and lead risk assessments of Nike systems and systems managed for Nike by vendors. You will also drive strategic advancement of Nike's Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program—establishing risk\-profiling methodologies, tiered assurance frameworks, vendor lifecycle controls, and executive reporting capabilities that protect Nike's most sensitive data across a complex global vendor ecosystem.

Beyond assessment execution and program delivery, this role carries a broader organizational mandate. You will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in information risk and cybersecurity not only within CIS, but across Nike. Partner teams including Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Engineering, and the broader Nike Business will look to you as a trusted, accessible authority on information risk. You will also identify, initiate, and lead cross\-functional programs that extend beyond IRM’s immediate scope, efforts such as enterprise\-wide data governance alignment or cross\-team risk standardization, bringing structure and momentum to problems that span organizational boundaries.

  

  

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**
-------------------------


This role works with the Information Risk Management team to identify, assess, elevate visibility to, and remediate information security risks across Nike's technology landscape. As a Principal\-level contributor, you will lead high\-complexity assessments, shape team methodology, mentor analysts, and own key TPRM program initiatives.

---------------------------------------------------


* **Advance TPRM capability maturity** by designing and implementing program rigor beyond control self\-assessments, including vendor risk profiling, risk\-based controls testing, and tiered assurance requirements
* **Establish and operationalize a standardized vendor risk\-profiling methodology** (e.g., data sensitivity, criticality, regulatory impact) to consistently categorize vendors by inherent risk tier and drive risk\-based assessment prioritization
* **Define and implement tiered assurance requirements** so that higher\-risk vendors undergo deeper validation (evidence reviews, control testing, security baseline documentation) while lower\-risk vendors follow appropriately scaled processes
* **Introduce targeted validation of high\-impact controls** (e.g., access management, data protection, availability) for critical suppliers, going beyond self\-attestation to validate design and operational effectiveness
* **Establish mandatory control effectiveness standards** requiring vendors to demonstrate effective design and operational execution for high\-impact controls prior to contractual engagement or network integration
* **Develop and operationalize TPRM metrics and executive reporting**, including third\-party blind metrics and integration into Executive TPRM Council reporting
* **Expand factory risk assessment program scope** and contribute to assurance activities for Nike's highest\-risk indirect and direct third parties
* **Plan and execute joint response planning tabletop exercises** with key direct and indirect suppliers to validate incident readiness and coordination capabilities

* **Build and steward a centralized vendor inventory** capturing all active vendors, associated services, and data\-sharing agreements, with inventory updates embedded into the global onboarding workflow

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager Data Center Services (Remote)
jobs.description:
EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications. We have over thirty manufacturing and assembly plants worldwide servicing over 10,000 customers in more than 100 countries. Worldwide headquarters are located in Reading, PA, USA with regional headquarters in Europe and Asia. We complement our extensive line of Motive Power and Energy Systems with a full range of integrated services and systems. With sales and service locations throughout the world, and over 100 years of battery experience, EnerSys is the power/full solution for stored DC power products.

  


**Job Purpose**
---------------



EnerSys Field Services is establishing a dedicated leadership role to launch and scale the NOIR battery solution for data center customers while governing a multi\-region portfolio of data center capital projects. This role is accountable for deployment readiness, project controls, customer execution, contractor performance, safety, quality, commissioning, financial performance, and service handoff. This leader will build a repeatable operating model that converts commercial commitments into safe, predictable, on\-time, and on\-budget deployments across North America.

**ROLE MANDATE:** Create the launch playbook, lead multiple regional projects simultaneously, and establish the governance, resources, partners, and service model required to scale NOIR in the data center market.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------


**NOIR launch and deployment readiness**

* Own the integrated launch plan and stage gates from customer requirements and site assessment through design, permitting, bill of materials, logistics, installation, commissioning, acceptance, warranty, and ongoing service.

**Capital portfolio leadership**

* Direct multiple concurrent data center capital projects across regions, balancing scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, customer commitments, and business priorities.
**Project governance and controls**

* Establish standard work, schedules, budget baselines, risk registers, change control, forecast cadence, executive dashboards, and closeout requirements.
**Technical and construction oversight*** Provide leadership across AC/DC power, battery and UPS systems, generators, switchgear, HVAC, controls, alarms, fire/life safety, commissioning, and critical\-facility work practices.
**Cross\-functional execution*** Align Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Field Services, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, Finance, Legal, and customer teams around a single deployment plan.
**Customer and executive leadership*** Serve as the senior point of accountability for project performance, escalations, decisions, recovery plans, and executive communications.
**Contractor and partner management*** Build and manage a qualified regional network of installation partners, commissioning resources, specialty trades, and suppliers with clear commercial and performance expectations.
**Safety, quality, and operational continuity*** Enforce safe work planning, MOP/SOP/EOP discipline, QA/QC, code compliance, test documentation, and zero\-impact execution in live data center environments.
**Workforce and service readiness*** Define staffing, training, certification, tools, spares, technical support, and handoff requirements so installations transition cleanly into warranty and lifecycle service.
**Continuous improvement and scale*** Capture lessons learned, reduce deployment cycle time, improve forecast accuracy, standardize designs and scopes, and drive repeatable margin and customer experience.
**First 12\-18 Month Priorities**
---------------------------------


**Launch operating model*** Publish the end\-to\-end NOIR deployment playbook, decision rights, stage gates, templates, acceptance criteria, and executive reporting cadence.
**Pilot\-to\-scale execution*** Deliver initial deployments with disciplined lessons learned and convert the pilot approach into a repeatable regional delivery model.
**Portfolio visibility*** Implement a single source of truth for project scope, schedule, cost, cash flow, risks, changes, resource demand, and customer commitments.
**Regional capacity*** Qualify contractors, establish coverage plans, and align technician training, commissioning capability, spares, and support resources with the sales pipeline.
**Service transition*** Create a formal turnover process from project delivery to monitoring, warranty, preventive maintenance, corrective service, and customer support.
**Qualifications**
------------------


**Experience*** 10\+ years in engineering, construction, capital program management, or operations within data centers, telecommunications, critical power, utilities, or other mission\-critical facilities.
**Leadership scale*** Demonstrated success leading managers, technical teams, contractors, and multiple concurrent projects across several geographic regions.
**Financial accountability*** Direct responsibility for large, multi\-million\-dollar capital portfolios, forecasts, project economics, change control, and executive reporting.
**Technical fluency*** Working knowledge of AC/DC power, batteries and UPS systems, generators, switchgear, HVAC, controls, alarms, and fire/life safety systems.
**Project lifecycle*** Experience from requirements definition and estimating through RFP/SOW development, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
**Critical\-environment discipline*** Proven ability to plan and execute work in 24/7 operating environments using formal risk controls, MOPs, quality plans, and stakeholder approvals.
**Education*** Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business, or a related field; equivalent military and industry experience may be considered.
**Travel*** Ability to travel regularly to customer, partner, and project sites throughout North America.

----------------------------

**Project Manager – IT Strategy \& Roadmap**

**Position Summary**


The Project Manager – IT Strategy \& Roadmap ensures that GDC’s IT Strategic Plan and enterprise architecture are consistently translated into execution, with clear alignment, traceability, and governance across all IT initiatives. Working closely with the Deputy Director of Architecture \& Planning and IT leadership, this position maintains the enterprise IT roadmap, tracks the delivery of strategic objectives, and helps ensure alignment with the organization’s target architecture, security posture, and long\-term technology vision. This role governs and coordinates the execution of IT strategy but does not own or approve enterprise architecture decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**IT Strategy and Roadmap Governance**

* Maintain and continuously update the multi\-year IT roadmap across applications, infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, and related technology domains.
* Translate strategic objectives into actionable initiatives with clearly defined timelines, milestones, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Maintain traceability between strategic goals, approved initiatives, project deliverables, and business outcomes.
* Ensure the IT roadmap remains aligned with organizational priorities and the long\-term technology vision.

 **Architecture Alignment and Governance**

* Confirm that IT initiatives align with enterprise architecture standards and approved target\-state designs.
* Support established architecture governance checkpoints throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify potential architecture drift, document concerns, and escalate issues to the appropriate architecture and IT leadership teams.
* Coordinate the resolution of architecture\-related dependencies without assuming ownership of architecture decisions.

 **Network and Architecture Documentation**

* Maintain accurate enterprise network diagrams covering on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

* Track the delivery of strategic IT initiatives against approved goals, timelines, milestones, budgets, and dependencies.
* Maintain dashboards and reports addressing project progress, risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, and outcomes.
* Ensure project deliverables clearly map to approved strategic objectives.
* Identify execution gaps and recommend corrective actions or escalation when necessary.

* Develop and maintain an inventory of prior tactical technology decisions.
* Assess whether existing tactical decisions align with the target architecture, cybersecurity standards, and long\-term technology strategy.
* Coordinate the development of remediation plans for identified gaps.
* Track remediation activities through completion and report progress to IT leadership.

* Develop clear executive\-level communications, presentations, dashboards, and status updates.
* Coordinate with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, consultants, and senior leadership.
* Communicate project risks, decisions, dependencies, and required actions in a timely and professional manner.

 **Governance and Continuous Improvement**

* Support IT governance, strategic planning, architecture review, and portfolio\-management processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve roadmap development, delivery tracking, governance, documentation, and reporting practices.
* Promote consistent application of approved project\-management and governance standards.

 **IT Steering Committee Governance and Administration**

* Coordinate IT Steering Committee meetings, agendas, materials, minutes, decisions, and follow\-up activities.

jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager (Planning – Payments Domain)
Who is Mastercard?
  

  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  

  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  

  

Overview
  

  

The Mastercard Network \& Digital Payment Services team is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own planning and delivery execution across our product and platform portfolio. You will run the planning function for the organization — roadmap, forecast, budget, headcount, and delivery commitments — across multiple concurrent programs.  

  

As Senior Technical Program Manager, you will work with product managers, tech leads, architects, and operations and engineering leaders to deliver complex programs. You will define roadmap deliverables, build execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, manage escalations, and balance business needs against delivery constraints.  

This is a planning and execution role rather than a hands\-on engineering one. jobs.description:
**Our Mission:** **Hospital\-Quality Care, Everywhere.**
========================================================


The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995\.


Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well\-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high\-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!

**Our Values:** **The Principles That Guide Us**
================================================


Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

* **We are transparent, upfront and direct.** We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.
* **We value speed of iteration.** We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.
* **We give 110% effort, 30% of the time.** We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.
* **We empathize with customers to a fault.** When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, *"How can we make this better?"* We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real\-world challenges of healthcare.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


Verse Medical is hiring a RevOps Analyst / GTM Engineer. This role is a critical hire as we build out the revenue operations function at Verse. This is one role with two halves. The analyst half answers the questions leadership cannot answer today: where pipeline comes from, where it stalls, and what the forecast actually is. The GTM engineer half builds the systems that stop those questions from being asked again: the Salesforce object model, the routing rules, the data pipelines, the automations and agents.


We sell to health systems, discharge planners, case managers, and post\-acute partners, which means one health system is many locations and many referral sources rather than one account. That shape makes territory design, routing, and pipeline analysis harder than a typical logo\-based motion, and worth doing well.


This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with no team and no backlog waiting for you. If you want to write only SQL, or only administer Salesforce, this is not the right role. If you want to find a broken revenue process and fix it end to end, it is.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Pipeline and Forecast Operations**

* Run pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and weekly revenue reporting with accurate data, clear summaries, and tracked follow\-up.
* Monitor stage progression, conversion rates, sales cycle length, deal slippage, stale opportunities, close\-date hygiene, and loss reasons, and say what they mean, not just what they are.
* Partner with sales leadership and AEs to improve pipeline inspection, deal movement, and accountability without adding unnecessary admin work.
* Own target account, territory, ownership, and routing logic as the team scales, including the fact that one health system is many locations and many referral sources, not one account.
* Model quotas, capacity, and comp plans, and produce the numbers that pay people correctly.

**CRM, Data, and AI\-Native Operations**

* Own Salesforce as a system, not a database: object model, fields, validation rules, flows, and permissions. Make the CRM reflect how we actually sell.
* Own day\-to\-day hygiene for required fields, lifecycle and stage accuracy, source attribution, account and contact quality, and data completeness.
* Design, test, and roll out workflows that improve fill rates, enforce required fields, flag stale or low\-quality data, and reduce manual cleanup.
* Build and maintain dashboards for funnel conversion, rep activity, meetings, pipeline, forecast, and source performance.
* Own the GTM stack end to end: what we buy, what we build, and how Salesforce, Gong, the warehouse, and outbound tooling talk to each other. Write the scripts and API integrations yourself.
* Build internal AI tooling that puts answers in front of reps and leaders without them opening a report: account briefs, deal\-risk alerts, automated CRM updates, Slack\-native lookups. We already run agents against Salesforce and Gong, and you will extend them and decide what gets built next.
* Use AI to compress the unglamorous work (data cleanup, enrichment QA, dedupe logic, first\-pass analysis, documentation) and build the evaluation alongside it. An agent that is right 80% of the time and silent about the rest is worse than no agent.
* Choose honestly between buying a tool, writing a script, and prompting a model, and be able to do the middle one yourself.
* Document core GTM processes and handoffs across marketing, SDR, sales, finance, and enablement.

**GTM Insights, Assets, and Operating Support**

* Act as the operational partner to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Enablement, and Clinical Operations. Translate each team's questions into data they can act on, and keep metric definitions consistent so they all work from the same numbers.
* Support Finance on quota, capacity, commission exports, and board report

jobs.description:

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Payments Operations Analyst to execute day\-to\-day operations and support the scaling of Tabs' payments program as we bring payments in\-house. You will work directly with our Senior Payments Operations Lead, helping to manage merchant operations, disputes, reconciliation, and exceptions as Tabs Pay launches and grows.


You'll be hands\-on and detail\-oriented, executing defined workflows and improving them incrementally. This role is ideal for someone who takes pride in making processes work reliably, escalating issues appropriately, and identifying practical bottlenecks. **What You'll Do**

* Strong track record of accurate, detail\-oriented work in high\-stakes operational environments where errors cascade downstream.

jobs.description:
Barnes \& Noble is the leading book retailer in the United States, with roots dating back to 1873 and a long history of growth through innovation and expansion. Today, under CEO James Daunt and private ownership by Elliott Advisors, Barnes \& Noble operates approximately 700 bookstores nationwide, serves over 700 communities across all 50 states, and maintains a robust digital presence through BN.com, NOOK® eBooks and audiobooks, and educational resources such as SparkNotes. The company also includes complementary retail brands such as Paper Source, Books Inc., Tattered Cover, and B. Dalton, further strengthening its market reach. Following a period of revitalization, Barnes \& Noble is experiencing strong momentum, with plans to open approximately 60 new stores in 2026, underscoring renewed confidence in physical retail and local bookselling. Combining expansive store networks, curated selections, enhanced in\-store experiences, and growing omnichannel capabilities, Barnes \& Noble remains the \#1 bookseller in the U.S. and a trusted, evolving partner within the publishing and retail ecosystem.  

  

An employee in this position can expect an annual salary between $60,000 \- $68,000 depending on experience, seniority, geographic locations, and other factors permitted by law.  

  

The Inventory Operations Analyst is responsible for ensuring Distribution Center (DC) product is handled efficiently, timely and accurately to support fast and reliable shipments to stores and ecommerce customers. This is accomplished by troubleshooting obstacles created by vendors, mismatched data or warehouse limitation. The Inventory Operations Analyst is also responsible for the liquidation of obsolete and surplus inventory within our Distribution Centers. This role partners cross functionally to drive efficient processes for the Distribution Centers, proactively identifying, creating, and implementing processes, procedures, and tools that reduce DC capacity constraints, maximize labor efficiency, reduce costs, and improve speed while maintaining accuracy. Their tasks and responsibilities contribute to the overall DC cycle time goals, increasing speed to market and supporting a dependable and reliable distribution process by spending time working and observing our warehouse operation.  

  

Position Responsibilities:  

* Oversees special order management workload, including key new releases, top priority items, author events, and manipulates DC\-to\-Store order allocations to achieve in\-store dates and fill rate goals, while controlling DC freight costs.
* Demonstrates strong analytical skills to effectively solve daily problems related to trouble receiving inventory and QC results.
* Organizes special projects for merchandise remediation, roll outs, destruction/MOS, price ticketing, and stock balancing; initiating cost recovery when appropriate.
* Partners with merchandise vendors to address operational non\-compliance and consistently drives Vendor behavior to a place of compliance.
* Works proactively with B\&N’s Merchandising teams to strategize successful and timely launches of top priority items, initiatives and new product types.
* Effectively analyzes data and processes to create reports, process maps and visualizations to illustrate issues (bottlenecks, costs, wasted labor) and opportunities for improvement (efficiencies, savings).
* Resolves Customer Service, ICS, and HO escalations related to DC inventory and shipments.
* Facilitates efficiencies in receiving/shipping of DC inventory.
* Creates and modifies the necessary tools to recommend actions needed in volume times.
* Responsible for new/closing store merchandise and related internal processes, ensuring outbound accuracy and timeliness.
* Ensure Business Development special handling order needs are met, communicating any exceptions.
* Contributes to our B\&N Vendor Operational Guidelines to drive vendor compliance and establish procedures for best practices with gains in efficiency.
* Achieves inventory health by curating lists of obsolete items/surplus inventory to be exited with merchant approval, and determines the appropriate exit strategy for the selected inventory; bulk/individual sale, donation, used book annex, etc.
* Additional job duties or responsibilities may be assigned.

  

Position Requirements:  

* Exercises sound judgment to effectively solve problems.
* Works collaboratively with others to meet the needs of the organization.
* Follows up to ensure all work requirements are completed in a timely and accurate manner.
* Must be team\-oriented and customer\-focused.
* Must contribute effectively and professionally in meetings (in person or virtual) with cross\-functional partners and vendors.
* Prioritizing and multi\-tasking.
* Works with a sense of urgency while maintaining high quality standards.
* Adhere to all safety protocols and foster a safe work environment.
* Work on the warehouse floor which includes regular lifting, bending, reaching, pulling and pushing of 10 \-35 lbs. with an occasional 50 lbs., and ability to stand for extended periods of time as needed.

NYC Health \+ Hospitals is the largest public health care system in the nation. We are a network of 11 hospitals, trauma centers, neighborhood health centers, nursing homes, post\-acute care centers, and correctional health services. We are a home care agency and a health plan, MetroPlus. Our health system provides essential services to 1\.4 million New Yorkers every year in more than 70 locations across the city's five boroughs. jobs.description:
**About Judi Health**
---------------------



Judi Health is a health technology company providing benefit administration solutions to employers, unions, health plans, and government entities. Judi Health replaces fragmented, outdated systems with the industry's first Unified Claims Processing™ architecture, seamlessly consolidating pharmacy and medical benefit administration on a single, secure platform. By delivering true price transparency, eliminating unnecessary middleman fees, and leveraging advanced AI\-powered care delivery, Judi Health helps clients achieve unprecedented operational efficiency and service levels.  

  

At Judi Health, we're deploying the infrastructure our country needs to deliver the healthcare we all deserve. We are the intelligence platform powering benefits plans for millions of Americans and proudly leading the next generation of care. To learn more, visit www.judi.health.


Location: Hybrid (Local to NYC, Denver, CO or Charlotte, NC)


**Position Summary:**



The Government Programs Operations Analyst supports operational functions across Medicare, Medicaid, Exchange, and Commercial lines of business, with the primary responsibility of serving as the Reprocessing \& Reversals (R\&R) subject matter expert. The Analyst executes and validates R\&R activities, provides operational and regulatory guidance, and works closely with Product and Development teams to design, test, and implement system and process enhancements. This role applies expertise in regulatory compliance and claims operations to resolve issues, maintain accurate documentation, and improve the integrity, efficiency, and scalability of operations.


**Position Responsibilities:**


* Serve as the primary Reprocessing \& Reversals (R\&R) subject matter expert, executing R\&R activities and supporting continuous process improvement across applicable lines of business.
* Run and validate R\&R activities, including complex claim reversals, reprocessing, retroactive changes, coordination\-of\-benefits adjustments, and other regulatory\- or client\-driven corrections.
* Partner with Product and Development teams to define R\&R business requirements, evaluate proposed solutions, prioritize enhancements, and ensure functionality supports operational, regulatory, and client needs.
* Perform operational testing and validation of R\&R enhancements, document outcomes and defects, and coordinate with Product and Development through implementation and post\-production monitoring.
* Establish and maintain R\&R procedures, controls, documentation, standard operating procedures, and audit\-ready evidence to support consistent and compliant execution.
* Provide R\&R guidance, training, and issue support to Operations, Client Services, Product, Development, and other internal stakeholders.
* Conduct root cause analysis of R\&R and claims\-processing issues, identify systemic trends, and implement corrective and preventive actions in collaboration with cross\-functional partners.
* Perform day\-to\-day operational tasks related to claims processes, including PDE, Medicare Plan Finder, and Encounter Data submissions, while assessing downstream impacts of R\&R activities.
* Support error handling and change management for PDE and encounter submissions, ensuring R\&R outcomes align with CMS, state, and client requirements.
* Stay current on CMS guidance and regulatory updates, translating changes into actionable operational strategies.
* Share R\&R knowledge and provide guidance to team members and cross\-functional partners as needed.
* Maintain current knowledge of Medicare \& Medicaid requirements to facilitate compliance of ongoing business operations.


**Required Qualifications:**


* 3\+ years of experience in PBM or health plan operations, with experience supporting Medicare Part D, Medicaid, Exchange, and/or Commercial
* Proven subject matter expertise in pharmacy claim reprocessing and reversals, including complex claim corrections, operational controls, issue resolution, and downstream regulatory reporting impacts.
* Advanced MS Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, data modeling); familiarity with SQL or other data tools is a plus.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with cross\-functional teams to define business requirements, support solution design, perform user acceptance testing, manage defects, and implement operational enhancements.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a track record of driving operational improvements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with operational and technical stakeholders.
* Deep understanding of CMS compliance requirements and audit readiness.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and committed to delivering high\-quality work.

 *All employees are responsible for adherence to the Judi Health Code of Conduct including the reporting of non\-compliance. jobs.description:
EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications. We have over thirty manufacturing and assembly plants worldwide servicing over 10,000 customers in more than 100 countries. Worldwide headquarters are located in Reading, PA, USA with regional headquarters in Europe and Asia. We complement our extensive line of Motive Power and Energy Systems with a full range of integrated services and systems. EnerSys Field Services is establishing a dedicated leadership role to launch and scale the NOIR battery solution for data center customers while governing a multi\-region portfolio of data center capital projects. This role is accountable for deployment readiness, project controls, customer execution, contractor performance, safety, quality, commissioning, financial performance, and service handoff. This leader will build a repeatable operating model that converts commercial commitments into safe, predictable, on\-time, and on\-budget deployments across North America.

* Own the integrated launch plan and stage gates from customer requirements and site assessment through design, permitting, bill of materials, logistics, installation, commissioning, acceptance, warranty, and ongoing service.

**Project lifecycle*** Experience from requirements definition and estimating through RFP/SOW development, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
**Critical\-environment discipline*** Proven ability to plan and execute work in 24/7 operating environments using formal risk controls, MOPs, quality plans, and stakeholder approvals.

jobs.description:

Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go\-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.


To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Citizen. This position requires an active U.S. Government security clearance, applicants who do not currently hold the required clearance will not be eligible for consideration. *Export Control/ITAR:* Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).

jobs.description:

Our solutions are tailored to support each client’s mission, accounting for their unique needs and operating environments to ensure success. We bring the right people, capabilities, and expertise together to assist our clients with enabling their mission. Together our individual differences drive successful business results.


If you are transitioning from military to civilian life, have prior service, are a retired veteran, or a member of the National Guard or Reserves, or spouse of an active military service member, we encourage you to apply. * **Make an Impact:** Work on meaningful projects that support critical missions and drive innovation.

This individual will provide program leadership, technical oversight, and strategic direction across cybersecurity architecture, engineering, cloud security, and system authorization efforts.


The ideal candidate is an experienced cybersecurity leader with a strong background managing large\-scale federal IT and cybersecurity programs. Job Type: Full\-time


Location: Remote, MD

**Dynanet Corporation Overview:**


Dynanet started with a focus on IT infrastructure and operations, helping organizations enhance their networks and overcome the limitations of 1990s technology. * Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi\-task federal IT contracts

* Demonstrated experience in IT Infrastructure project management.?
* Proven expertise in managing complex information systems architectures involving multiple databases and networks.?
* Proven expertise in managing AWS environments and working knowledge of AWS Cloud technology.???
* Knowledge of FISMA requirements.?
* While the Project Manager may designate Senior Staff as Task Leads, the Project Manager must possess the technical skills to serve as a Technical Lead and provide technical direction for all contract tasks.?

**Preferred Professional Skills:**

* Master’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* CISSP or related security certification
* AWS architect or related certification
* ITIL Foundation Certificate (v3 or higher)
* Agile scrum master certification or demonstrated working knowledge

**Dynanet Team Requirements and Expectations:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including experience presenting to senior federal officials.?
* Desire ability to continuously learn, challenge yourself and advance IT services delivery in the Federal space
* Strong judgment and creative problem\-solving skills.
* Timely responsiveness of team and client requests via email, MS teams, or other communication channels during core business hours.
* Experience managing cost, performance, and schedules on tasks

**Education/Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Masters degree preferred.
* Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience, including 4 years specialized in federal IT project management.

* *Remote Work\**
* Paid Training
