jobs.title: Senior Program Manager Data Center Services (Remote)
jobs.description:
EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications. We have over thirty manufacturing and assembly plants worldwide servicing over 10,000 customers in more than 100 countries. Worldwide headquarters are located in Reading, PA, USA with regional headquarters in Europe and Asia. We complement our extensive line of Motive Power and Energy Systems with a full range of integrated services and systems. With sales and service locations throughout the world, and over 100 years of battery experience, EnerSys is the power/full solution for stored DC power products.

  


**Job Purpose**
---------------



EnerSys Field Services is establishing a dedicated leadership role to launch and scale the NOIR battery solution for data center customers while governing a multi\-region portfolio of data center capital projects. This role is accountable for deployment readiness, project controls, customer execution, contractor performance, safety, quality, commissioning, financial performance, and service handoff. This leader will build a repeatable operating model that converts commercial commitments into safe, predictable, on\-time, and on\-budget deployments across North America.

**ROLE MANDATE:** Create the launch playbook, lead multiple regional projects simultaneously, and establish the governance, resources, partners, and service model required to scale NOIR in the data center market.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------


**NOIR launch and deployment readiness**

* Own the integrated launch plan and stage gates from customer requirements and site assessment through design, permitting, bill of materials, logistics, installation, commissioning, acceptance, warranty, and ongoing service.

**Capital portfolio leadership**

* Direct multiple concurrent data center capital projects across regions, balancing scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, customer commitments, and business priorities.
**Project governance and controls**

* Establish standard work, schedules, budget baselines, risk registers, change control, forecast cadence, executive dashboards, and closeout requirements.
**Technical and construction oversight*** Provide leadership across AC/DC power, battery and UPS systems, generators, switchgear, HVAC, controls, alarms, fire/life safety, commissioning, and critical\-facility work practices.
**Cross\-functional execution*** Align Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Field Services, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, Finance, Legal, and customer teams around a single deployment plan.
**Customer and executive leadership*** Serve as the senior point of accountability for project performance, escalations, decisions, recovery plans, and executive communications.
**Contractor and partner management*** Build and manage a qualified regional network of installation partners, commissioning resources, specialty trades, and suppliers with clear commercial and performance expectations.
**Safety, quality, and operational continuity*** Enforce safe work planning, MOP/SOP/EOP discipline, QA/QC, code compliance, test documentation, and zero\-impact execution in live data center environments.
**Workforce and service readiness*** Define staffing, training, certification, tools, spares, technical support, and handoff requirements so installations transition cleanly into warranty and lifecycle service.
**Continuous improvement and scale*** Capture lessons learned, reduce deployment cycle time, improve forecast accuracy, standardize designs and scopes, and drive repeatable margin and customer experience.
**First 12\-18 Month Priorities**
---------------------------------


**Launch operating model*** Publish the end\-to\-end NOIR deployment playbook, decision rights, stage gates, templates, acceptance criteria, and executive reporting cadence.
**Pilot\-to\-scale execution*** Deliver initial deployments with disciplined lessons learned and convert the pilot approach into a repeatable regional delivery model.
**Portfolio visibility*** Implement a single source of truth for project scope, schedule, cost, cash flow, risks, changes, resource demand, and customer commitments.
**Regional capacity*** Qualify contractors, establish coverage plans, and align technician training, commissioning capability, spares, and support resources with the sales pipeline.
**Service transition*** Create a formal turnover process from project delivery to monitoring, warranty, preventive maintenance, corrective service, and customer support.
**Qualifications**
------------------


**Experience*** 10\+ years in engineering, construction, capital program management, or operations within data centers, telecommunications, critical power, utilities, or other mission\-critical facilities.
**Leadership scale*** Demonstrated success leading managers, technical teams, contractors, and multiple concurrent projects across several geographic regions.
**Financial accountability*** Direct responsibility for large, multi\-million\-dollar capital portfolios, forecasts, project economics, change control, and executive reporting.
**Technical fluency*** Working knowledge of AC/DC power, batteries and UPS systems, generators, switchgear, HVAC, controls, alarms, and fire/life safety systems.
**Project lifecycle*** Experience from requirements definition and estimating through RFP/SOW development, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
**Critical\-environment discipline*** Proven ability to plan and execute work in 24/7 operating environments using formal risk controls, MOPs, quality plans, and stakeholder approvals.
**Education*** Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business, or a related field; equivalent military and industry experience may be considered.
**Travel*** Ability to travel regularly to customer, partner, and project sites throughout North America.
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three\-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation's top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best\-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

**Program Manager**


**\*\*Contracts awaiting on Final Award from government Procurement. Pipeline estimate 60 – 90 days.** **MUST have active TS/SCI clearance**


**General Description**

We are looking for a skilled Program Manager who will lead the development, implementation, and communication of cybersecurity programs for the federal government sector. Responsible to strategic thinking and alignment, stakeholder management and communication, and program planning and coordination. Coordinate multi\-functional teams, guide vendor selection, oversee budgets and schedules. Deliver briefings, presentations, and project status updates to senior government stakeholders, CISOs, and C\-suite executives.


**About the Federal Region**



GuidePoint Security is the trusted partner that defense and civilian government agencies rely on to lead their cybersecurity efforts and protect their organizations. We help solve their most complex security challenges, mature security architectures, and proactively reduce risk. Our purpose\-built solutions ensure compliance, safeguard critical assets, and align security with organizational objectives. * Developing Team Capabilities – Work at an individual and team level to develop project growth and opportunities beyond initial project scope.
* Communication \- Own all project communications to project members and stakeholders on progress, issues, and risks including regular status updates and periodic white paper analysis; ability to brief C\-suite executives, CISOs, security analysts, and compliance officers.

* 12\+ years of direct Project Management experience.

* 7\+ years of experience managing a Program with over 10 people
* 7\+ years of experience in public sector/DOD/IC contract management
* A BS degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent hands\-on experience in software engineering or IT infrastructure.
* Required Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification
* Required Security\+ Certification
* Required Certified Scrum Master (CSM) Certification
* Knowledge and awareness of the certification in the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework standards for information technology (IT) infrastructure, development, and operations
* Demonstrated exceptional leadership, communication, time management, facilitation, and organizational skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office/Microsoft Project/Atlassian Jira/Atlassian Confluence
* Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes

**Location:** Aberdeen Proving Ground (APG), MD  

**Type: Remote \+ Travel**  

**Salary Range:** $139,000 – $174,000

**About Fairwinds Technologies**


Fairwinds Technologies is a U.S.\-based engineering firm specializing in Satellite Communications (SATCOM), RF Transmission Systems, Network Design, Systems Integration, and Digital Signal Processing (DSP). We support Command, Control, Communications, and Computer (C4\) systems in austere military environments, delivering advanced communications, networking, and IT solutions to defense and civilian agencies worldwide.

**Position Overview**


Fairwinds Technologies is seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead the end\-to\-end development and fielding of international telecom, SATCOM, and satellite gateway infrastructure in support of Department of War and commercial customers.


This role manages the lifecycle from early site identification and technical due diligence through site acquisition, permitting, partner and vendor selection, infrastructure implementation, equipment deployment, integration, acceptance, and operational turnover.


The Technical Program Manager works closely with engineering teams, logistics providers, installation and hosting partners (e.g., AST or local subcontractors), government representatives, host\-nation authorities, utilities, and commercial site owners to ensure each gateway site meets technical, operational, regulatory, quality, safety, schedule, and cost requirements.


This highly field\-oriented position supports multiple efforts, including DIU task orders and other international deployment initiatives, requires frequent travel and recurring on\-site inspections, and reports under the R\&D Programs Director.

	+ Lead or support the identification, evaluation, and acquisition of international gateway sites, for permanent, temporary, and expeditionary deployments.
	+ Conduct and coordinate technical, operational, regulatory, environmental, security, access, constructability, utility, communications/backhaul, and infrastructure suitability assessments for overseas deployment locations.
	+ Plan and support domestic and international site surveys with engineering teams, subcontractors, commercial partners, government stakeholders, and host\-nation representatives.
	+ Manage international RFIs/RFPs, competitive procurements, and acquisition activities, including requirements development, market research, proposal evaluation, vendor due diligence, and support to subcontract.
	+ Support commercial and technical coordination with landowners, facility operators, telecommunications providers, utilities, engineering and construction firms, local authorities, government ministries, regulatory agencies, and other host\-nation stakeholders.
	+ Confirm real\-estate, leasing, right\-of\-entry, land\-use, zoning, environmental, construction, utility, and other site\-development approvals required to support international infrastructure deployment.
	+ Support host\-nation regulatory and governmental coordination for telecommunications operations, including spectrum authorization, frequency coordination, licensing, permitting, equipment approvals, and other country\-specific regulatory requirements.
	+ Coordinate with U.S. Government, partner\-nation government, diplomatic, military, commercial, and regulatory stakeholders to resolve deployment dependencies and enable fielding activities.

	+ Verify the coordination of international logistics, including equipment staging, packaging, transportation, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, temporary import/export, permanent importation, export compliance, in\-country transportation, warehousing, inventory accountability, and configuration control.
	+ Coordinate applicable U.S. and host\-nation import/export processes, customs documentation, shipping requirements, end\-use documentation, equipment certifications, and release procedures.

	+ Support the coordination of spectrum and frequency activities required for fielding and testing, including spectrum requests, frequency assignments, temporary operating authorizations, interference coordination, regulatory submissions, and engagement with applicable host\-nation spectrum authorities.
	+ Support and conduct system installation, integration, commissioning, testing, and operational activation by coordinating engineering teams, field personnel, customers, government representatives, and commercial partners.
	+ Conduct or coordinate recurring site inspections and deployment readiness reviews to assess schedule, workmanship, safety, quality, technical compliance, regulatory compliance, and readiness to proceed to subsequent phases.

The Technical Program Manager works closely with engineering teams, logistics providers, installation and hosting partners (e.g., AST or local subcontractors), government representatives, host\-nation authorities, utilities, and commercial site owners to ensure each gateway site meets technical, operational, regulatory, quality, safety, schedule, and cost requirements.

	+ Develop and maintain integrated deployment plans spanning acquisition, regulatory approvals, site preparation, infrastructure construction, utility provisioning, equipment shipment, customs clearance, installation, integration, testing, activation, acceptance, and transition to operations.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is excited to continue supporting the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.

  



Our **Program Manager (Technical Planning Project Manager),** located in Crystal City, Arlington, VA, provides program management support to the F\-35 JPO, Future Capability and Technology (FCAT) Support in achieving Kill\-Chain dominance through Intelligence, robust Operational Analysis (OA), requirements integration and analysis, and Research and Technology exploration, for all elements of the F\-35 Air System. The Contractor shall support FCAT in leading, identifying, maturing, informing, and transitioning capability candidate nominations and integration planning for insertion into the F\-35 Air System Program of Record (PoR), to and on behalf of the U.S. Services, International Partner countries, and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The Contractor shall assist FCAT in leading select key Governance forums for pre\-PoR execution, driving decision\-making for improvements to the F\-35 Air System, with an emphasis on lethality and survivability, synthesizing with the PMOs and supporting Functional Teams. The Contractor shall assist in managing the F\-35 modernization strategy planning for capabilities beyond Block 4, enabling the F\-35 enterprise to shape future investments to address emergent threats and drive decisions for new capability sets prioritizing mission accomplishments and closing mission gaps. The Contract shall assist FCAT in maintaining and updating existing JPO/FCAT tools to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and relevance for all authorized users.

  



**This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain/transfer an active U.S. Department of War (Dow) Secret security clearance.**

	+ Assist FCAT in maturing and recommending for approval all new F\-35 requirements, developing the Flight Plan or equivalent and New Capabilities Decision Memoranda.
	+ Assist in operational analysis efforts, integrating across FCAT, and performing operational assessments over time for all mission sets to include purpose, objectives, summaries, findings, path forward for each operational analysis.
	+ Assist FCAT in engaging with other operational analysis entities to support the identification and prioritization of mission and capability gaps. Identify gaps from advanced adversaries and emerging technologies and recommend technologies to close those gaps.
	+ Assist FCAT in analyzing the F\-35 Operational Assessment (OA) plans, methodologies, and output data and summarize the results for modernization upgrades.
	+ Support tactics and concept of operations (CONOPS) development.
	+ Governance Structure – assist FCAT in leading Requirements Working Group (RWG), Operational Advisory Group (OAG), Senior Warfighter Group (SWG), JSF (Joint Strike Fighter) Executive Steering Board (JESB) and in assisting with Configuration Steering Board (CSB) and requirements portion of the U.S. Executive Steering Group.

Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

The ideal candidate is a **strategic leader and integrator** who can bridge program management, technology, cybersecurity, cloud, AI/ML, and software delivery without needing to be the hands\-on technical expert. jobs.title: Data Center Project Manager, Critical Projects Implementation
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operational data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.  

  

We are currently seeking a Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data center facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi\-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system. The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.  

  

About the team  

\*Why AWS\*  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

\*Diverse Experiences\*  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

\*Work/Life Balance\*  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

\*Inclusive Team Culture\*  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

\*Mentorship and Career Growth\*  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

\#DCCD\_AMER

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

BryceTech is seeking an Emergency Management Analyst to fill a critical need supporting the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Office of Emerging Threats (OET). The person in this role will:

* Provide training and advisement to FEMA employees on regulations, threat analysis documents, and interactions with various emerging threat stakeholders

The ideal candidate will possess strong federal cybersecurity experience, knowledge of the Risk Management Framework (RMF), and experience assessing vulnerabilities and implementing security controls.

* Monitor security tools including Splunk, Tenable, Qualys, and ServiceNow.
* Support assigned Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities.

* Identify and document issues within Risk Registers, Plans of Action and Milestones (POA\&Ms), and audit artifacts.

About DMI:

DMI is a leading provider of digital services and technology solutions, headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA. With a focus on end\-to\-end managed IT services, including managed mobility, cloud, cybersecurity, network operations, and application development, DMI supports public sector agencies and commercial enterprises around the globe. Recognized as a Top Workplace, DMI is committed to delivering secure, efﬁcient, and cost\-effective solutions that drive measurable results. Learn more at www.dminc.com
About the Opportunity:

DMI, LLC is seeking an experienced **Program Manager** to lead complex technology programs within a Federal Government environment. The ideal candidate has a record of delivering mission\-critical programs in one or more technology domains, including software development, systems integration, IT infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, or enterprise technology operations.  

The Program Manager is accountable for overall program performance and serves as the primary delivery leader for the customer, program team, stakeholders, subcontractors, and technology partners. This role oversees contractual commitments, customer outcomes, financial performance, staffing, schedule, scope, quality, risk, compliance, and technical delivery. The Program Manager anticipates and resolves delivery challenges, and ensures the program achieves its mission, business requirements and contractual objectives. **Duties and Responsibilities:*** Lead the planning, execution and delivery of complex federal technology programs involving one or more of the following: application development, systems integration, infrastructure modernization, cloud, cybersecurity, enterprise systems, or technology operations.
* Maintain accountability for program cost, schedule, scope, quality, staffing, contractual performance, customer satisfaction, and mission outcomes.
* Serve as the primary program delivery interface with government program leadership, Contracting Officers, Contracting Officer's Representatives, technical stakeholders, subcontractors, vendors, and company leadership.
* Translate contractual requirements, performance work statements, statements of work, task orders, and customer priorities into an integrated program plan with defined milestones, deliverables, dependencies, resources, and performance measures.
* Establish and maintain program governance, including program management reviews, operating cadences, executive reporting, decision management, risk and issue escalation, change control, and corrective\-action management.
* Manage program financial performance in coordination with Finance and Contracts, including budgets, forecasts, funding, labor utilization, cost\-to\-complete, and margin performance, as applicable.
* Monitor contract deliverables, service\-level agreements, key performance indicators, quality measures, and other performance commitments; take timely corrective action when performance deviates from plan.
* Direct schedule management across technical and operational workstreams, including milestones, critical dependencies, staffing requirements, customer decisions, and contract deliverables.
* Lead the management of program scope, requirements, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and change requests, ensuring decisions and impacts are documented and communicated.
* Apply Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches appropriate to the contract, customer environment, and nature of the work.
* Provide program\-level oversight of application development, systems integration, testing, deployment, release management, production support, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, or other assigned technical workstreams.
* Partner with technical leaders to ensure solutions are feasible, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned with customer mission and enterprise architecture requirements.
* Lead workforce planning, staffing, onboarding, performance management and allocation of resources across program activities.
* Establish clear roles and performance expectations across employees, subcontractors, vendors and technical teams; monitor and address performance concerns promptly.
* Identify emerging risks and opportunities, develop mitigation and contingency plans and escalate matters requiring customer or executive action with clear recommendations.
* Prepare and deliver accurate program status reports, dashboards, performance reviews, forecasts and customer communications.
* Ensure program activities and deliverables comply with contractual requirements, federal policies, security obligations and quality standards.
* Maintain complete and current program records, including plans, schedules, action items, risk and issue registers, deliverables, performance evidence, lessons learned and other required artifacts.
* Lead transition\-in, program startup, operational readiness and when applicable, transition\-out activities while protecting service continuity, contractual performance, customer relationships and workforce stability.

Serco is excited to continue supporting the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


The F\-35 JPO International Directorate (ID) is the focal point for all F\-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F\-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F\-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the Foreign Military Sales USG Program Managers who represent the Foreign Military Sales Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Foreign Military Sales nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program.


Our **Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst,** F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO), Crystal City, Arlington, VA, is responsible for advising JPO FMS leadership on current security cooperation policy, case development and case execution practices. * Review and interpret directives from higher authority regulations, instructions, periodicals, and publications to maintain current expertise and knowledge.
* Ensure new technology and lessons learned are incorporated into F\-35 FMS processes; establishes suitable methods of assessing and continually improving processes.
* Develop, evaluate, advise, and improve efficiency and effectiveness of work methods and procedures, and manpower utilization.

* Coordinate with Security Cooperation Enterprise to assist country teams in completing Pricing and Availability (P\&A), Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs), amendment and modification packages in Security Cooperation systems, including DSAMS and RMIS.
* Use strong communication skills including the ability to communicate orally, via written letters and memorandum, email, and presentation. Ability to prepare and present convincing oral and written presentations at all levels of government and industry, and foreign allies.

* An active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A Bachelor’s degree plus a minimum of 3 years out of 6 years of recent work experience related to international acquisition programs.
	+ OR an Associates degree and 4 years of additional work experience related to international acquisition programs (total of 10 years of work experience).

Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Pantheon Data was founded in 2011, initially providing acquisition and supply chain management services to the US Coast Guard. **DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Application deadline: Sep 27, 2026  

  

Bringing a new AWS data center online starts with fiber in the ground. In this role you own that work across high\-volume US metro markets, taking a metro fiber route from approved plan to live capacity and managing the construction vendors who build it.  

  

You will run several builds at once, hold vendors to schedule and quality, inspect sites to confirm the work was done right, and keep a wide group of stakeholders current on where each project stands. If you have built fiber before, you will move fast here. If you have run complex physical infrastructure or construction programs in another field, you can succeed here too: the hard part of this job is owning an ambiguous program end to end and driving it to delivery, and we will teach you the fiber.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of metro fiber construction projects, from approved plan through in\-service handover
* Manage construction vendors to schedule and quality: track milestones, measure performance, and drive corrective action when standards are not met
* Run quality control across the build: inspect conduit and vault installation, validate designs in the field, and review splice and fiber acceptance test results and as\-built accuracy before handoff to internal customers
* Deliver weekly status reporting to leadership and internal customers, and manage risk, escalations, and competing priorities across multiple concurrent builds
* Coordinate site access and approvals in security\-regulated environments, and travel to field sites up to 50% of the time

  

A day in the life  

Most days your focus is knowing the true status of every build you own and moving each one forward. You will scan vendor progress and open risks, make the calls that unblock a permit or a crew, and update the trackers your stakeholders rely on. You work day to day with construction vendors and general contractors, fiber engineers, data center and networking teams, and permitting authorities. Some weeks you will be on a site confirming the build matches the design and the test results hold up. Beyond the steady work of delivery, you will also help improve the standards and processes the team runs on. This is a field\-facing role rather than a remote one, and you will spend real time on site.  

  

About the team  

Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development \- Fiber Deployment plans, manages, and delivers the physical fiber network that connects AWS data centers. The high\-volume metro team delivers the fiber that brings new AWS capacity online across our busiest metro markets. You will work alongside construction vendors, engineers, and the internal customers who depend on that capacity, building large\-scale fiber networks on time and to a high quality bar. AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Product & Innovation
jobs.description:
In a world where old school soft drinks, unnecessary food waste and outdated business practices are a thing of the past, DASH is leading the healthy hydration revolution. We infuse our super tasty waters with real wonky fruit. That’s the bent, crushed, misshapen fruit that supermarkets say no to. No sugar, no sweeteners, no worries.


DASH launched in 2017 and has quickly become the market leading brand in a category that has grown over 60% YoY in the UK. DASH has an industry\-leading DTC platform, and in 2026 we will sell over 56 million cans in 20\+ international markets with notable retailers including: Sainsbury’s, Tesco, Waitrose, Ocado and M\&S.


We are incredibly proud to say that we are a Certified B Corporation. We always intend to use our business as a force for good, and now it’s official.

**The opportunity**  

Ready to bring the next wave of DASH to life? This is a big, bright, brilliant opportunity to shape the next generation of products powering the hydration revolution.


As our Senior Project Manager you'll be the driving force behind a pipeline of world class products. From bold new ideas in Innovation and New Product Development (NPD) through to the clever tweaks that make our existing range even better (EPD), you'll steer every product and packaging project from the first spark of an idea all the way to the shelf.


You'll bring the perfect blend of ingenuity, invention and control. One day you'll be championing a fresh concept. The next you'll be keeping a complex launch on track. You'll own the DASH framework for bringing new products to market, making it slicker, smarter and more fun to work with as we grow.


You'll be the heartbeat of our product delivery, connecting the talented people doing the work across the business with the Steering Group and SLT who give it the green light. You'll report to our Operations Director, partner closely with our Brand Director and collaborate with teams right across DASH.


If you love turning great ideas into real products, bringing people together and seeing your work make a splash, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key responsibilities:**


Project Delivery \& Coordination

* Act as day\-to\-day Project Manager for DASH’s NPD and other new projects: own the plan, timeline and cross\-team coordination from concept through to launch.
* Coordinate delivery of EPD projects, working closely with the cross functional project team to keep development briefs, timelines and SLT check\-ins on track.
* Own and maintain a single, up\-to\-date view of all current and future product\-related projects — EPD, NPD, innovation and other — giving the business one source of truth on status, timelines and resourcing.
* Ensure every project uses DASH’s project management process, matching the level of governance to the size and risk of the work, so delivery is consistent regardless of who is running it.


Gate \& Governance Process

* Own the project framework (concept, business case/feasibility, ready\-to\-launch, close \& review): preparing gate packs, coordinating input from the Steering Group/SLT, and ensuring go/no\-go decisions are clearly documented.
* Be responsible for reporting on all projects to the SLT


Cross\-functional Coordination

* Coordinate input and deadlines across the team, wider functions and externally — chasing actions and unblocking issues.
* Be the first point of contact for status, timeline and risk questions on any live product project.
* Step in and do whatever it takes to get a project delivered


Continuous Improvement

* Build our innovation delivery engine as well as owning and evolving DASH’s project management framework
* Capture lessons learned at the close of each project and feed improvements back into the process.
* Support the onboarding of new team members into DASH’s way of running projects.


Other Assignments

* Support ad hoc cross\-functional projects as directed by the Operations Director.
* Responsibility for assigned B Corp questions.
* Perform other duties as required or assigned by the SLT.

 **Requirements**  

What we are looking for:

* Someone who is passionate about innovation in food and drink. You will likely have flavour and portfolio strategy experience (though not essential).
* Proven project management experience, ideally within FMCG, food \& beverage, or another fast\-moving consumer\-facing business. A clear passion for the products you have worked on and a desire to work in the drinks category.
* A track record of coordinating cross\-functional teams (commercial, brand, operations, finance) to deliver projects on time and to budget, without direct authority over the people involved.
* Comfortable running a structured stage\-gate process for larger, higher\-risk projects, and a lighter\-touch process for smaller ones \- and confident judging which is which.
* Highly organised, with strong attention to detail on plans, risk logs and reporting; keeps track of many moving parts at once without letting things drop.
* Commercially numerate, comfortable owning or reviewing a project budget/business case with the SLT.
* A confident, clear communicator, able to translate cross\-functional input into a simple plan and status update that non\-specialists can act on.
* Comfortable managing conflicting priorities and holding people to deadlines they don’t report into you for, without damaging relationships.
* An ability to work in product development without necessarily having experience as a product developer
* A formal project management qualification (e.g. PRINCE2, APM, AgilePM) is an advantage but not essential \- practical delivery experience matters more.
* Proficient with Excel, Project Management software and comfortable using AI tools
* Interest in sustainability within FMCG and an ability to evaluate the environmental impact of decisions made in the context of DASH’s supply chain.

* Competitive salary and discretionary bonus

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Our Program Manager's are always thinking about the bigger picture. Every position at Amazon offers the opportunity for employees to influence business decisions and shape the future. Collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, you’ll continuously be scoping out new solutions. * Take a big\-picture approach in your analysis of business operations, driving improvements across a range of teams and organizations
* Work alongside senior leadership to establish and prioritize improvement programs, seeing them through from start to finish

As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll drive and manage the implementation of creative, data\-driven change in Amazon, leading improvement projects and programs. You’ll use strategic thinking to define and implement an efficient project plan. At AMZL Europe, we deliver millions of packages daily to customers at record speed and quality. The work that Launch and Expansion do is at the heart of that. Our relentless ambition is to make AMZL Europe more and more cost\-effective and customer centric. We’re doing that by improving our existing network, inventing new and creative ways of making last\-mile delivery more efficient, and optimizing the development of our Under the Roof and On Road Infrastructure. Within the team we have a variety of roles. Typical examples include program managers responsible for selecting and launching new sites, planners working out how we solve challenges such as low emission zones and EV charging, strategy teams looking at how we get the most out of our existing buildings, and analysts using data to deliver insights into how we work and how we should be working.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager Data Center Services (Remote)
jobs.description:
EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications. We have over thirty manufacturing and assembly plants worldwide servicing over 10,000 customers in more than 100 countries. Worldwide headquarters are located in Reading, PA, USA with regional headquarters in Europe and Asia. We complement our extensive line of Motive Power and Energy Systems with a full range of integrated services and systems. With sales and service locations throughout the world, and over 100 years of battery experience, EnerSys is the power/full solution for stored DC power products.

  


**Job Purpose**
---------------



EnerSys Field Services is establishing a dedicated leadership role to launch and scale the NOIR battery solution for data center customers while governing a multi\-region portfolio of data center capital projects. This role is accountable for deployment readiness, project controls, customer execution, contractor performance, safety, quality, commissioning, financial performance, and service handoff. This leader will build a repeatable operating model that converts commercial commitments into safe, predictable, on\-time, and on\-budget deployments across North America.

**ROLE MANDATE:** Create the launch playbook, lead multiple regional projects simultaneously, and establish the governance, resources, partners, and service model required to scale NOIR in the data center market.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------


**NOIR launch and deployment readiness**

* Own the integrated launch plan and stage gates from customer requirements and site assessment through design, permitting, bill of materials, logistics, installation, commissioning, acceptance, warranty, and ongoing service.

**Capital portfolio leadership**

* Direct multiple concurrent data center capital projects across regions, balancing scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, customer commitments, and business priorities.
**Project governance and controls**

* Establish standard work, schedules, budget baselines, risk registers, change control, forecast cadence, executive dashboards, and closeout requirements.
**Technical and construction oversight*** Provide leadership across AC/DC power, battery and UPS systems, generators, switchgear, HVAC, controls, alarms, fire/life safety, commissioning, and critical\-facility work practices.
**Cross\-functional execution*** Align Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Field Services, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, Finance, Legal, and customer teams around a single deployment plan.
**Customer and executive leadership*** Serve as the senior point of accountability for project performance, escalations, decisions, recovery plans, and executive communications.
**Contractor and partner management*** Build and manage a qualified regional network of installation partners, commissioning resources, specialty trades, and suppliers with clear commercial and performance expectations.
**Safety, quality, and operational continuity*** Enforce safe work planning, MOP/SOP/EOP discipline, QA/QC, code compliance, test documentation, and zero\-impact execution in live data center environments.
**Workforce and service readiness*** Define staffing, training, certification, tools, spares, technical support, and handoff requirements so installations transition cleanly into warranty and lifecycle service.
**Continuous improvement and scale*** Capture lessons learned, reduce deployment cycle time, improve forecast accuracy, standardize designs and scopes, and drive repeatable margin and customer experience.
**First 12\-18 Month Priorities**
---------------------------------


**Launch operating model*** Publish the end\-to\-end NOIR deployment playbook, decision rights, stage gates, templates, acceptance criteria, and executive reporting cadence.
**Pilot\-to\-scale execution*** Deliver initial deployments with disciplined lessons learned and convert the pilot approach into a repeatable regional delivery model.
**Portfolio visibility*** Implement a single source of truth for project scope, schedule, cost, cash flow, risks, changes, resource demand, and customer commitments.
**Regional capacity*** Qualify contractors, establish coverage plans, and align technician training, commissioning capability, spares, and support resources with the sales pipeline.
**Service transition*** Create a formal turnover process from project delivery to monitoring, warranty, preventive maintenance, corrective service, and customer support.
**Qualifications**
------------------


**Experience*** 10\+ years in engineering, construction, capital program management, or operations within data centers, telecommunications, critical power, utilities, or other mission\-critical facilities.
**Leadership scale*** Demonstrated success leading managers, technical teams, contractors, and multiple concurrent projects across several geographic regions.
**Financial accountability*** Direct responsibility for large, multi\-million\-dollar capital portfolios, forecasts, project economics, change control, and executive reporting.
**Technical fluency*** Working knowledge of AC/DC power, batteries and UPS systems, generators, switchgear, HVAC, controls, alarms, and fire/life safety systems.
**Project lifecycle*** Experience from requirements definition and estimating through RFP/SOW development, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
**Critical\-environment discipline*** Proven ability to plan and execute work in 24/7 operating environments using formal risk controls, MOPs, quality plans, and stakeholder approvals.
**Education*** Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business, or a related field; equivalent military and industry experience may be considered.
**Travel*** Ability to travel regularly to customer, partner, and project sites throughout North America.
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

jobs.description:

**SUMMARY**



The Office of Diversion and Reentry (ODR) is seeking a Health Program Analyst I to support the Referral, Access and Data (RAD) Team. RAD supports ODR's housing access and referral operations across multiple stages of the ODR service continuum, including individuals entering ODR from custody into interim housing placement, and ongoing access to Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH) resources through the county’s Flexible Housing Subsidy Pool (FHSP).



The HPA I will act as a primary liaison between ODR contracted community based providers and the Los Angeles Superior Court to ensure timely bidirectional communication of information, including hearing dates, progress reports, and other court notifications. Additionally, the HPA I will support ODR's court and central release process with housing access for individuals entering ODR, assisting with interim housing referrals and placements, and supporting the management and utilization of ODR's PSH resources.



The HPA I will analyze referral and housing data, monitor resource utilization and placement activity, identify barriers and delays, support data quality and reporting, and assist with improvements to referral and housing\-access workflows. The successful candidate will have strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to coordinate across multiple teams and systems serving individuals with complex housing, behavioral health, and justice needs.



Currently, ODR has a hybrid work schedule with a combination of workdays in the office, in the field and remote. This may change at discretion of Los Angeles Health Services.



ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS of the HPA I include, but are not limited to:


* Review, track, and ensure timely submission of progress reports to the Los Angeles Superior Court, in collaboration with community based providers.
* Support ODR referral and access processes across assigned programs, including tracking referrals from initial receipt through disposition, placement, enrollment, or another applicable outcome.
* Monitor referral workflows and identify delays, gaps, incomplete information, or other barriers that may affect timely access to services.
* Maintain and update referral tracking systems, databases, spreadsheets, and other tools used to monitor client movement through ODR referral processes. Assist with the creation of new client profiles and maintain accurate client records.
* Review referral information for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance with established program procedures. Meet with clients in custody to orient them to the ODR program and prepare them for transition to community\-based services.
* Coordinate with ODR staff to resolve data discrepancies, obtain missing information, and facilitate timely updates to referral records.
* Develop and maintain standardized tracking tools and workflow processes to improve consistency and efficiency.
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, spreadsheets, summaries, and other analytical products.
* Participate in special projects and analytical assignments as directed by ODR leadership.
* Collaborate with ODR program teams, administrative staff, clinical staff, and other stakeholders to support referral and access activities.
* Participate in meetings and workgroups related to referral processes, data management, program access, and performance improvement.

**Option I:** A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Social Work, Counseling, Health Care Administration/Management, Public Administration, Behavioral Sciences, Social Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field \-AND\- two years of direct professional experience working with persons experiencing homelessness, serious mental illness, or justice involvement, in the role of case manager, clinician, outreach worker, program manager, or similar.

* Direct experience working with justice\-involved populations and/or within systems of care (e.g., housing, mental health, substance use treatment).

* License or certification as a substance use counselor, or at least 1\-year professional experience conducing substance use screening or assessments.
* Experience coordinating discharge planning from carceral settings, hospital or healthcare settings, SUD treatment programs, or similar.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data entry, tracking, and reporting).
* Strong organizational skills and ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

* A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job\-related essential functions.
* Successful clearing through the DHS Live Scan, Health Clearance and LASD Clearance process with the County of Los Angeles.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager - Retention Campaign Specialist
jobs.description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.


Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.


Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.


At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

**The Job**


The Associate Project Manager \- Retention Campaign Specialist supports the planning, execution, and delivery of retention and renewal campaigns across markets. This role works closely with Retention Specialists, Data \& Analytics,  

Product, Pharmacy, Member Services, Sales, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure campaign activities are organized, timely, within scope, and measurable.


The role prepares and maintains campaign plans, tracks progress, coordinates outreach readiness, identifies and escalates risks, maintains documentation, and helps translate campaign results into actionable insights that support member retention.

**You Will**

* Support the planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of retention and renewal campaigns across markets, ensuring activities are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with campaign objectives.
* Prepare and maintain campaign plans, timelines, trackers, project documentation, outreach schedules, and status reports for internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end campaign logistics, including member files, outreach readiness and training, tracking needs, workflow alignment, and follow\-up activities.
* Partner with Retention Specialists, Data \& Analytics, Product, Pharmacy, Member Services, Sales, and other cross\-functional teams to support campaign execution, issue resolution, and follow\-up needs.
* 5 Maintain campaign trackers to document member lists, outreach status, completion progress, participation, outcomes, risks, dependencies, and next steps.
* Review campaign requirements, identify interdependencies, coordinate work activities and schedules, and ensure assigned tasks are completed according to established timelines.
* Monitor campaign progress, identify and escalate barriers, delays, or risks, and support resolution within predefined guidelines and structured plans.
* Compile post\-campaign results, including participation, outreach completion, retention outcomes, member feedback themes, lessons learned, and recommended improvements.
* Help identify opportunities to improve future campaigns through trend review, process documentation, issue tracking, and post\-campaign analysis.
* Support market\-specific and national campaigns as assigned, ensuring consistent execution, communication, documentation, and reporting across workstreams.
* We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.
* Actively support the achievement of SCAN’s Vision and Goals.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Your Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
* 0\-2 years of project management, campaign coordination, operations, sales support, or member retention experience or related experience in the healthcare, health plan, or related industry experience required.
* 1\-2 years of leadership, project coordination, workstream coordination, or related experience preferred.
* Certifications deemed reasonable to function at this level preferred.
* Basic leadership skills with the ability to coordinate work efforts, follow up on deliverables, and support cross\-functional teams.
* Good problem\-solving skills, including the ability to identify risks, barriers, and dependencies and escalate issues appropriately.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with internal stakeholders and cross\-functional partners.
* Ability to prepare and maintain project plans, timelines, trackers, documentation, and status reports.
* Ability to support planning, coordination, execution, and documentation within structured plans and predefined guidelines.
* Ability to exercise judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and approaches for obtaining results within established parameters.
* Ability to track progress against milestones, organize campaign details, and communicate updates clearly and accurately.
* Ability to compile, review, and summarize campaign results, member feedback themes, and recommended improvements.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate schedules, and follow through on time\-sensitive deliverables.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle member, campaign, and business information with discretion.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Outlook, Teams), Visio, and SQL are required.

**What's in it for you?**

* Base salary range: $80,300 to $100,000 per year.
* Work Mode: Mostly Remote
* An annual employee bonus program
* Robust Wellness Program
* Generous paid\-time\-off (PTO)
* Eleven paid holidays per year, plus 1 floating holiday, plus 1 birthday holiday
* Excellent 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with employer match and contribution
* Robust employee recogniti

* Able to understand, balance, and manage the interplay between people, processes and systems

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager- AI Learning Operations
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


At Udacity (a part of Accenture), we aim to bring accessible, engaging, and highly relevant education to the world. We believe that education is not limited to four years or four walls, it’s a lifelong pursuit. Technology is advancing rapidly; there is a growing skills gap between jobseekers and career opportunities, and between an enterprise’s strategies and employee’s skill to execute. Udacity is dedicated to closing these gaps. To do this, we're rethinking how education is made and delivered by empowering our students to advance themselves personally and professionally.

 **The Work:**

**Senior Program Managers** **for Learning Operations** plan and run the programs that deliver each pod's roadmap. They own the plans, timelines, dependencies, and coordination that turn a pod's intent into delivered learning, keeping content and video work sequenced so parallel work lands together. They track commitments against delivery, surface slippage early, clear blockers, and communicate status to pod members, Video Production team, and Learning Experience leadership. They run the operating rhythm for the programs they own, planning cadences, stand\-ups, and reviews.

  

The **Senior Program Manager** will own the largest and most cross\-cutting programs, including leadership of key initiatives within the **AI Pod and across the Learning Experience organization**. The role will establish delivery standards for the PMO, drive strategic cross\-functional initiatives, and provide people leadership to one Program Manager who reports to them.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan and drive programs end\-to\-end: scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, and delivery against the roadmap.
* Track commitments against delivery, surfacing slippage early, and driving recovery.
* Coordinate across pods (content, video, architecture) so parallel work lands together.
* Manage communication with internal ALV stakeholders.
* Clear blockers and manage risks and escalations to keep programs moving.
* Communicate clear, timely status to pod members, Video Production team, and LX leadership.
* Run the operating rhythm: planning cadences, stand\-ups, release readiness, and reviews for the programs they own.
* Manage process improvement and strategic initiative workstreams.

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 4 years of program and project management experience
* Bachelor's degree

 **Professional Skills Requirements:**

* Experience within the EdTech industry
* Awareness of adult learning theory and principles
* Experience with AI tooling for planning, status, and reporting work

 **Professional Skills Requirements:**

* Ability to manage programs involving interdependent workstreams, including dependency mapping and risk tracking
* Deep reporting discipline, including how to structure status so slippage shows up early.
* Drives delivery amid ambiguity; makes calls and unblocks without waiting for perfect clarity.
* Anticipates slippage before it becomes a miss; stays organized and proactive.
* Communicates and influences across pods, functions, leads, and stakeholders.
* Manages and grows people, sets clear expectations, gives constructive, actionable feedback, and nurtures development.
* Sees the pattern behind repeated delivery problems and fixes it at the process level

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Ads Delivery Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**About Pinterest:**



Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we're on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.



Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other's unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It's Possible.



At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we're looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we'll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.



Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

**The Team**



Pinterest's Ads Delivery Infrastructure team builds and operates the real\-time serving, indexing, retrieval, and budgeting systems that power Shopping and Ads at Pinterest. We're in the middle of a significant modernization effort: unifying our catalog and index platforms to scale to billions of items, moving core services onto our next\-generation compute platform, and re\-architecting our budgeting systems for real\-time accuracy. We work closely with engineering, product, and monetization teams to keep Pinterest's advertising systems fast, reliable, and ready to scale.


**What You'll Do:**


* Lead or support programs that scale Pinterest's Shopping and Ads catalog, indexing, and retrieval systems to handle billions of items, partnering with engineering leads across catalog, search infrastructure, and retrieval.
* Drive cross\-team execution on infrastructure modernization initiatives, including migrations to next\-generation compute and storage platforms, managing timeline, dependency, and risk across service owners.
* Build and maintain program dashboards and reporting that give engineering and business stakeholders a clear, current view of progress, risk, and decisions.
* Partner with engineering on reliability and incident\-response initiatives for revenue\-critical serving systems.
* Communicate technical tradeoffs and program status clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences, from individual engineers to senior leadership.
* Use GenAI as the default operating model for EP PgM execution—producing AI\-assisted first drafts of core program artifacts, modernizing high\-toil workflows into AI\-first mechanisms (e.g., intake triage, status synthesis, action/decision extraction, risk \& dependency tracking), and synthesizing signals to proactively surface risks, decision/trade\-offs, and escalation paths.
* Prototype solutions to augment decisions through data (e.g. dashboards, data analysis) or simplify processes (e.g. process and workflow helpers, or internal tools) using AI coding assistants ("vibe coding").
* Follow Pinterest AI guidance for risk, governance, and safety\-by\-design: appropriately handle sensitive data, validate AI\-generated outputs, document assumptions/limits, and ensure AI\-assisted workflows meet applicable policy/compliance expectations before broad adoption.

  


**What We're Looking For:**


* 5\+ years of TPM/Product Ownership experience leading complex, cross\-functional technical programs, ideally within large\-scale distributed systems, search/retrieval, or ads/monetization infrastructure.
* Solid understanding of the principles behind large\-scale serving, indexing, or retrieval systems, and the tradeoffs involved in scaling them.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with experience building dashboards, interpreting data, and using insights to drive decisions.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering with senior engineering and business stakeholders in high\-visibility settings.
* Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities across a fast\-moving, multi\-workstream roadmap.
* Experience with ads, monetization, or data infrastructure is a plus; willingness to learn and grow across domains is essential.
* Workflow design, AI fluency, data \& insights orientation: experience turning repeatable program work into durable, low\-toil mechanisms and improving decision\-making by using GenAI (e.g., strong prompting, vibe coding lightweight scripts/tools, dashboards, data analysis and leveraging agents where appropriate)
* Safety\-by\-design AI fluency: experience operating within AI governance expectations (risk assessment, data handling, model/output validation, auditability/traceability) and proactively identifying where AI use is not appropriate or requires additional controls.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field or equivalent experience.

  



Join us and help scale the infrastructure behind Pinterest's Shopping and Ads business!

  


**Relocation Statement:**


* This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

jobs.title: Medicare Compliance Program Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.


Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.


Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.


At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

**The Job**


Leads compliance program administration, technology enablement, process improvement, analytics, and regulatory implementation activities that support the effectiveness and maturity of the Compliance Program. Partners with Compliance, business operations, and technology teams to ensure regulatory requirements are effectively implemented, monitored, and documented while identifying opportunities to leverage technology, workflow automation, data analytics, and artificial intelligence to strengthen program oversight, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance

**You Will**


Compliance Program Administration \& Strategy\- Lead and support compliance program administration activities, initiatives, and projects designed to strengthen the effectiveness, scalability, and maturity of the Compliance Program. Focus areas include policies and procedures, training and education, departmental communications, compliance investigations, reporting, etc.


Technology, Automation \& AI Enablement\- Identify opportunities to leverage technology, analytics, workflow automation, and artificial intelligence to improve Compliance Program effectiveness, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance. Work with stakeholders to define and translate business requirements into systems specifications.


Compliance Technology \& Systems\- Support the implementation, optimization, administration, and continuous improvement of compliance technology platforms, reporting solutions, regulatory libraries, and workflow management tools.


Regulatory Implementation \& Change Management\- Coordinate and monitor implementation of federal and state regulatory requirements, ensuring actions are assigned, tracked, documented, and completed in collaboration with Compliance and business stakeholders.


Cross\-Functional Program Leadership\- Serve as a liaison between Compliance, business operations, and technology teams to facilitate successful project execution, regulatory implementation, and program initiatives.

As the Program Manager, Employee Experience, you are the creative producer, event architect, and visual activation engine behind our company culture and employee engagement. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About HUD**
=============


HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25\.

**About the role**
------------------


We’re looking for a Technical Program Manager to own complex, time\-sensitive data and evaluation programs for frontier AI labs, data vendors, and internal teams. You’ll turn ambiguous technical asks into executable programs, coordinate the people and dependencies required to deliver them, and ensure the resulting data is genuinely useful for evaluating and improving LLMs and agents. You’ll also manage vendors and build the processes, tooling, and operating rhythms that allow HUD to deliver reliably at increasing scale.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own data and evaluation programs end\-to\-end, from initial scoping and requirements gathering through production, quality assurance, delivery, and retrospective
* Translate ambiguous requests from AI labs and internal teams into clear specifications such as milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, etc.
* Maintain and improve data quality procedures using both quantitative signals and qualitative inspection, including analyzing task coverage, difficulty, reward distributions, etc.
* Maintain and improve delivery pipelines at scale, which includes managing external vendors throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Streamline the logistics behind data production and evaluation programs by improving workflows, documentation, automation, and cross\-functional handoffs
* Partner with research, platform, marketplace teams to translate learnings and feedback into product improvements

**Experience**
--------------

**You may be a good fit if you have:**

* Experience owning complex technical programs in AI/ML, data operations, support engineering, applied research, forward\-deployed engineering, or a similarly cross\-functional environment
* Strong quantitative and qualitative judgment about data—you can move between aggregate metrics and individual examples to determine whether a dataset or evaluation is useful, reliable, and representative
* Experience maintaining and improving complex processes, especially within project delivery or data contexts
* Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, maintain momentum as requirements change, and make sound tradeoffs without waiting for a perfect specification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn messy technical information into clear decisions, owners, and next steps

**Strong candidates may also:**

* Experience with RLHF, reinforcement\-learning environments, agent evaluations, human\-in\-the\-loop data pipelines, annotation, or expert data collection
* Experience supporting frontier AI labs, technical enterprise customers, or research teams with urgent and evolving requirements
* Early\-stage startup experience with ability to work independently in fast\-paced environments

*We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.*

**Team \& company details**
---------------------------

* **Team Size**: \~25 people currently, mostly full\-time in\-person, but some remote.
* **Our team:** Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.
* **Company stage:** We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand.

**Logistics**
-------------

* **Employment**: Full\-time.
* **Location**: We have offices in San Francisco or Singapore but are open to remote candidates who **can work hours that 70\-80% overlap with either San Francisco or Singapore time zones.**
* **Visa Sponsorship**: We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full\-time candidates to the US or Singapore.
* **Timeline**: Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2\-3 day work trial.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation
* 100% covered top\-of\-the\-line medical, dental, and vision from Blue Shield of CA (US employees)
* Lunch and dinner when you’re in the office (in\-office employees)
* Company\-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays
* Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees)
* Unlimited\* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. \**By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is.*


Due to high volume, we may not actively respond to every application, but feel free to contact us at recruiting@hud.so or elsewhere if we missed your application!
